description: No specific Q4 domestic gathering established — Searches found an older 2015 call, a charitable concert and a government company ultimatum; none reports an eligible Q4 public gathering. Annobón rights reports are follow-up to July, while a November UN forum reference is a delegation abroad.

No candidate with documented 50 simultaneous participants — Search-result report of the Nov 10 concert has no attendance estimate and lacks a government-directed demand. No other Q4 report of a domestic public mobilization surfaced in these searches.

Regional/sector coverage incomplete — Searches covered Malabo, Bata, Mongomo, Ebebiyín, Evinayong, Luba, Annobón and sectors including education, transport/taxis and public work, but did not systematically search local-language or all district archives.
required_followup: Follow up in local/regional media and labour/education sources.

description: Local-language gap — Spanish, English and French used; no competent Fang, Bubi or Fa d’Ambô searches.
Open-web method and baseline limitation — No LexisNexis-equivalent archive search and no official 2024 baseline available.

Staging log serialization deviation — Some appends to the stage search_log.jsonl contain literal backslash+n delimiters; the effective snapshot log will be separately generated from parseable records, preserving stage bytes and documenting the transformation. No scientific content is inferred from that transformation.
